column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a word of pain” is rendered “a harsh word.”
Close to the Hebrew; תֵּיטִיב (“makes good”) is rendered “uses… rightly.”
Close to the Hebrew; “healing of tongue” is rendered “A wholesome tongue.”
Close to the Hebrew; לֹא־ כֵן (“not so / not right”) is rendered “does not do so.”
Close to the Hebrew; “evil discipline” is rendered “Harsh discipline.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Sheol and Abaddon” is rendered “Hell and Destruction.”
Close to the Hebrew; רָעִים (“are evil”) is rendered “are evil,” and “good of heart” “of a merry heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a portion of vegetables” is rendered “a dinner of herbs,” and “ox” “calf.”
Close to the Hebrew; סְלֻלָה (“is built up”) is rendered “is a highway.”
Close to the Hebrew; “makes straight to walk” is rendered “walks uprightly.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִשְּׁאוֹל (“from Sheol”) is rendered “from hell.”
Close to the Hebrew; “pleasant words are pure” is rendered “the words of the pure are pleasant.”
Close to the Hebrew; “fattens the bones” is rendered “makes the bones healthy.”
